Functions

void *usb_hid_driver_inst_alloc(void)

Allocate the HID function instance, which possesses independent function.

Example

Please refer to How to Implement USB HID Interface.

Returns:

HID function instance.

int usb_hid_driver_inst_free(void *inst)

Free HID function instance alloacted by usb_hid_driver_inst_alloc.

Example

Please refer to How to Implement USB HID Interface.

Parameters:

inst -- The instance alloacted by usb_hid_driver_inst_alloc.

Returns:

Refer to rtl_errno.h.

int usb_hid_driver_if_desc_register(void *inst, void *hs_desc, void *fs_desc, void *report_desc)

Register HID interface descriptors to the driver.

usb_hid_driver.h

Example

Please refer to How to Implement USB HID Interface.

Parameters:

  • inst -- HID instance returned by usb_hid_driver_inst_alloc.

  • hs_desc -- HID interface descriptor of high speed.

  • fs_desc -- HID interface descriptor of full speed.

  • report_desc -- HID report descriptor.

Returns:

Refer to rtl_errno.h.

int usb_hid_driver_if_desc_unregister(void *inst)

Unregister HID interface descriptors.

usb_hid_driver.h

Example

Please refer to How to Implement USB HID Interface

Parameters:

inst -- HID instance returned in usb_hid_driver_inst_alloc.

Returns:

Refer to rtl_errno.h.

void *usb_hid_driver_data_pipe_open(uint8_t ep_addr, T_USB_HID_DRIVER_ATTR attr, uint8_t pending_req_num, USB_HID_DRIVER_CB cb)

Open HID data pipe.

usb_hid_driver.h

Example

Please refer to How to Implement USB HID Interface.

Parameters:

  • ep_addr -- The endpoint address.

  • attr -- The attribute of T_USB_HID_DRIVER_ATTR.

  • pending_req_num -- The number of supported pending requests.

  • cb -- The application callbacks of USB_HID_DRIVER_CB, which will be called after data transmission is completed.

Returns:

HID handle.

int usb_hid_driver_data_pipe_close(void *handle)

Close HID data pipe.

usb_hid_driver.h

Parameters:

handle -- The return value of usb_hid_driver_data_pipe_open.

Returns:

Refer to rtl_errno.h.
